summary.business_type: B2B manufacturer + service-area business (UPS / power electronics), HQ Peenya Bangalore, 8 regional offices
top_findings: Conflicting company facts: founding 1978 vs CIN 1997, four phone numbers, ~31 legacy Organization schema blobs
~20 legacy Bangalore/India keyword-variant pages cannibalise each other (doorway risk)
No named author (AUTHOR = null); no case studies or first-hand evidence
No security or cache headers in vercel.json
quick_wins: Add headers block (security + immutable cache) to vercel.json
Standardise primary phone and brand name in footer.js and schema.js
Set a real AUTHOR in src/data/author.js
Real per-post dates and sitemap lastmod on all 192 URLs

findings.title: No security headers
findings.recommendation: Add HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, frame-ancestors, Permissions-Policy, CSP report-only

findings.title: Nav link to noindex /comming-soon
findings.description: 194 pages link to it via legacy nav
findings.recommendation: Remove link or build the page under a correct slug

findings.title: Thin legacy redirect coverage
findings.recommendation: Diff old indexed URLs vs dist and add 301s

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Accurate blog posts with worked examples, tables, FAQs

findings.title: No named author or reviewer
findings.description: AUTHOR=null; posts by Organization; 2/58 posts with first-hand phrasing
findings.recommendation: Named engineer author, reviewer line, case studies

findings.title: Legacy keyword-variant cannibalisation
findings.recommendation: Consolidate to one hub per intent with 301s

findings.title: Inconsistent or unsourced trust claims
findings.recommendation: Confirm, cite or drop; show certificates and clients

findings.title: Templated city pages
findings.description: 36-46% overlap; distant cities claim local AMC
findings.recommendation: Keep only cities with real local proof

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: One H1 on every indexable page

findings.title: Weak legacy titles and descriptions

findings.title: FCBC page title missing 'float cum boost'

findings.title: Mega-menu inside main content on legacy pages
